blocks.p: These Terms and Conditions govern access to and use of the WENZE TII NDAKU platform. By accessing or using the platform, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms.

ul: **Platform:** WENZE TII NDAKU website and services.
**Seller:** Any entity registered to sell on the platform.

blocks.p: Sellers must display only lawful, genuine and quality products. Any reference to drugs, crime, terrorism, child pornography, or illegal activities is strictly forbidden and prosecutable.
Defective or non-compliant products must be fully reimbursed at the seller's charge.

ul: **Membership fee:** 10 United States Dollars per month.

blocks.p: Seller revenue is paid once at the end of each calendar month, after deductions.
The platform may terminate any seller account immediately in the event of suspicious or unacceptable behavior.
Advertising non-existent items or false advertising is strictly prohibited and prosecutable.
WENZE TII NDAKU acts as an intermediary marketplace and is not liable for seller misconduct.
These Terms are governed by applicable commercial laws under the platform's legal jurisdiction.

intro.p: This Vendor Contract ("Agreement") is concluded between WENZE TII NDAKU (the "Platform") and the registered vendor ("Vendor"). By registering and operating on the Platform, the vendor agrees to be legally bound by this Contract.

blocks.p: This agreement governs the conditions under which the vendor is authorized to register and sell products on the WENZE TII NDAKU platform.
The vendor undertakes to display only legal, authentic and quality products, and to comply with all applicable laws and regulations.

Any product or activity related to drugs, crime, terrorism, pedophilia, human trafficking, weapons or other illegal activities is strictly prohibited and subject to immediate termination, reporting to the authorities and prosecution.
The vendor bears full responsibility for defective, damaged or non-conforming products and undertakes to fully refund buyers.
The vendor agrees to pay a monthly fee of 10 United States Dollars and a commission of 10% on the total volume of monthly sales made on the platform.
The vendor's revenue is paid once at the end of each calendar month, after deduction of the applicable fees and commissions.
The Platform reserves the right to suspend or immediately terminate the vendor account in the event of suspicious or unacceptable behavior.
The vendor retains ownership of the product content but grants the platform a non-exclusive right to use this content.
The platform acts only as an intermediary marketplace and is not responsible for faults committed by the vendor.
This Agreement is governed by the applicable commercial laws within the legal jurisdiction of the Platform.
The platform is strictly reserved for persons aged **at least eighteen (18) full years**.
Any registration, access or use by a minor is formally prohibited.
If the platform is used by a minor, **responsibility lies exclusively with the parents, legal guardians or persons responsible for the minor concerned**.
The platform reserves the right:

ul: To carry out any necessary verification in case of doubt or suspicion about a user's real age;
To require a **valid official identity document** to confirm the declared age;
To **suspend or delete the account** of any user who does not meet this condition or refuses to cooperate with the verifications.

blocks.p: Any false declaration regarding age constitutes a violation of the general terms and conditions of use and may lead to appropriate sanctions.
By registering on the Platform, the vendor confirms full acceptance of this Agreement.

blocks.p: This policy applies to all users of the platform.

ul: **Identification data:** surname, first name, phone number, email address and postal address.
**Vendor data:** identity document, Trade and Personal Property Credit Register number (Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier) where applicable, and bank details.
**Technical data:** Internet Protocol address, device, browsing data and cookies.

blocks.p: Your data is used for account management, order processing, payments, delivery, fraud prevention, security and legal compliance.
Your data is processed on the basis of the performance of a contract, your consent, our legitimate interest and the applicable legal obligations.
Your data may be shared with:
Personal data is never sold.
Data may be hosted outside the Democratic Republic of Congo, with appropriate security safeguards in place.
We apply technical and organizational measures, including access control and fraud protection.
Data is retained according to the period of use and the applicable legal obligations.
You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability.
To exercise these rights, contact: wtn-customers@outlook.com
Cookies are used for analysis, security and improving the user experience.
The platform is not intended for persons under the age of 18 without parental permission.
The platform acts as an intermediary between vendors and buyers.
This policy may be changed at any time.
Use of the platform constitutes acceptance of this policy.

**WENZE TII NDAKU, Société à Responsabilité Limitée**
Email: wenzetiindaku@outlook.com
WhatsApp (messages only): +32 495 84 68 66
This Return and Refund Policy governs the conditions that apply to products purchased on the WENZE TII NDAKU platform.

WENZE TII NDAKU acts exclusively as an intermediary platform (marketplace) connecting independent vendors and buyers. The products sold are offered and shipped by third-party vendors registered on the platform.
The customer has seven (7) calendar days from the date the product is received to submit a return request through their user account.
Any request made after this period may be refused, except in justified exceptional cases.

ul: Product not matching the published description

**1.1 What is WENZE TII NDAKU?**
WENZE TII NDAKU is a Congolese digital marketplace that connects vendors and buyers on a single secure platform. You can buy beauty products, clothing, accessories, technology products and much more.

**1.2 Where does WENZE TII NDAKU operate?**
WENZE TII NDAKU operates mainly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, in Kinshasa and Lubumbashi, with a vision of pan-African and international expansion.

**1.3 Does WENZE TII NDAKU sell the products directly?**
No. WENZE TII NDAKU is an intermediary platform. Products are sold by independent vendors registered on the platform. WENZE TII NDAKU only manages the transactions on the platform and the delivery operations.

You will receive a confirmation by email or text message.

**2.3 Which payment methods are accepted?**
WENZE TII NDAKU accepts:

Payment on delivery for certain items

blocks.p:
**2.4 Is payment secure?**
Yes. Transactions are protected by encryption systems that comply with international standards.

**2.5 How long does delivery take?**
The time depends on the vendor, the availability of the product and the delivery city. However, we try to guarantee deliveries in less than 5 days.

**2.6 Can I return a product?**
Yes, if the product is damaged, does not match the description, or if the vendor accepts returns. The conditions are specified on each product page.

WENZE TII NDAKU charges platform usage fees and a commission on monthly sales volume, or optional promotional fees. The conditions are specified in the vendor contract.

Payments are released after delivery confirmation and the expiry of the claim period. Payouts are made monthly according to the internal policy.

It is prohibited to sell illegal products, counterfeits, expired or dangerous products. WENZE TII NDAKU reserves the right to suspend any account in violation.

Your personal data is protected in accordance with international digital security standards.

Go to My Account → My Orders → Report a problem. The WENZE TII NDAKU team will analyze the situation and propose a solution.

Yes, in case of fraud, failure to comply with the general terms and conditions, or abusive behavior.
